want.pri.help: {s} isn't searched for, a {p} dub is enough
pulse.noArr: Neither Radarr nor Sonarr is connected
banner.setup: First choose the dub language to look for – until then the library isn't scanned.
banner.readOnly: Read-only preview – nothing is downloaded, imported or deleted.
proposals.title: Upgrade proposals
proposals.lead: Better versions of what you already have: {order}, then higher quality. Only live torrents are offered, and each one is re-checked before downloading.
proposals.leadSetup: Better versions of what you already have – first by audio language, then by quality.
proposals.empty.title: No proposals yet
proposals.empty.scanning: Updaterr is working through the library – {items} queued{eta}. As soon as it finds a better version, it'll show up here.
proposals.empty.done: The library has been checked. New movies and series are checked automatically.
proposals.setup.title: Choose your dub language
proposals.setup.text: Updaterr looks for releases dubbed in the language you want, ideally together with the original. Pick the language in Settings → Languages and the library check starts.
proposals.nameGuessTitle: MediaInfo doesn't list the language – guessed from the file name
proposals.speechTitle: The tracks are tagged as {tag}, the recognized speech is {audio}
proposals.otherSeasonsTitle: The proposal only concerns this season
option.guessTitle: The language is guessed from the release name
option.smallestTitle: Smallest suitable audio source – the video isn't taken from it
library.lead: {movies} and {seasons}. The language is detected from the files' actual audio tracks. Click a row to open its details.
library.bulkPTitle: Queues every item without a {p} dub
library.syncTitle: Reload the library from Radarr and Sonarr
library.col.title: Title
library.stat.syncInfo: Sync of the {p} dub against {s} is measured gradually in the background
library.mixedTip: A season is rated by its worst episode – {list}
library.syncTip: Measured by comparing the {p} and {s} tracks – {lag}. Can be fixed in the details.
library.fixAllTitle: Starts a sync fix for every shown item with an out-of-sync dub

drawer.watchEverySeries.one: Checked every {count} day (otherwise after {recheck} days), including new seasons.
drawer.watchEverySeries.other: Checked every {count} days (otherwise after {recheck} days), including new seasons.

drawer.autoOnSeries: Turned on automatically on {date} as a new series.
drawer.autoOnMovie: Turned on automatically on {date} as a new movie.
drawer.autoHelp: Downloads the best confident version (min. {n} seeds) without asking – you just get a notification.
drawer.wantSeries: Applies to the whole series, including new seasons.
langcheck.title: Language by listening
langcheck.intro: Track tags sometimes lie (e.g. a track in another language tagged as “eng”). Whisper listens to the tracks and recognizes the language from the speech.
sync.title: Dub sync
sync.lagsSentence: The dub lags behind the original
sync.leadsSentence: The dub runs ahead of the original
sync.warnUpTo: {p} dub off by up to {ms} ms
sync.fixRunning: Fix in progress – see {link} for progress.
sync.fixNote: The fix creates a new file with the {p} track shifted (video and other tracks unchanged), measures it again and only then imports it via {app}. The original file is kept as a backup.
sync.fixedFrom: Fixed by Updaterr – the offset used to be {ms} ms ({lag}).
sync.checkTitle: Measure again right now (without waiting in the queue)
activity.lead: Approved downloads, audio merges and dub sync fixes. Dead torrents are swapped for the next candidates automatically, and the language is verified from the audio tracks after import.
activity.empty.title: Nothing running
activity.empty.text: Once you approve a proposal, you'll see its progress here.
activity.fix.skipped: in sync after precise measurement ({ms} ms), nothing changed
activity.fix.result: {p} dub {ms} ms ({lag}, match {m}) → after the fix {v} ms (match {vm})
activity.retriedTitle: Previous attempts failed, the torrent was swapped for another one
activity.noMatch.title: Nothing found
activity.noMatch.text: Try another filter or search term.
backups.lead: Original files that Updaterr replaced while merging audio or fixing dub sync – so you can go back if the result isn't right. A backup is a hardlink, but after import Radarr/Sonarr deletes the original from the library, so from then on it takes up its full size.
backups.ret.title: Retention
backups.ret.lead: Applies to all backups except those with a custom date. After a failed import, a backup is kept for at least {n} days. Verification and cleanup run every 10 minutes.
backups.ret.maxHelp: 0 = no limit · the oldest are deleted above the limit
backups.ret.delVerHelp: the library file is compared with the backup – if they differ, the backup stays and you get a notification
backups.empty.title: No backups
backups.empty.text: Backups are created when merging audio and fixing sync.
backups.expiry.orphan: manually only – there is no job record for this backup
backups.blockedTitle: The import state is uncertain – the backup is kept for at least 30 days and isn't deleted because of size
backups.hardlinkTitle: The files are also in the library (hardlink) – deleting won't free any space
backups.fileSharedTitle: The file is also in the library (hardlink)
backups.verifyTitle: Compare the library files with the backup
backups.check.okTitle: Library files verified against the backup {date}: video, duration, audio tracks and sync
backups.check.reviewTitle: The backup won't be deleted automatically until you check it
backups.check.pendingTitle: Verified within 10 minutes – the library file against the backup
backups.check.notMergedTitle: The job ended before import – the original file stayed in the library, the backup is extra
backups.added.title: Track taken from the donor
backups.added.titleOffset: Track taken from the donor, shifted by {off} to match the video
log.lead: What Updaterr has been doing – searches, proposals, downloads and their results.
settings.lead: Changes take effect once saved. Credentials and notification channels are configured in the {file} file.
settings.noResults.title: Nothing found
settings.noResults.text: Try another word – both names and descriptions are searched.
settings.restartTitle: The new value takes effect after the container restarts
settings.err.minMax: The minimum is higher than the maximum
settings.err.language: Choose a language – without it the library isn't scanned
settings.err.sameLanguage: Must differ from the dub language
settings.need.qbit: Doesn't work without qBittorrent – set QBIT_PASSWORD in .env
settings.need.speech: whisper is missing from the container – the language is detected from track tags only
settings.need.notify: No channel is enabled – set up Telegram or ntfy in .env
settings.conn.title: Connections
settings.conn.lead: Credentials are configured in the .env file and the docker-compose volumes. This only shows their status.
conn.qbitMissing: {env} – track merging doesn't work without it
conn.speechMissing: whisper is missing from the container
conn.gpu.off: off – Whisper runs on the CPU
settings.webhook.title: Instant check of new downloads
settings.webhook.help: In both Radarr and Sonarr, open {path}, tick {a} and {b} and paste the URL. A newly downloaded file is then checked right away.
settings.lang.title: Languages
settings.lang.lead: Which dub to look for. The order is: both languages › the wanted one only › the second one only; with the same language, higher resolution wins. Changing the languages cancels pending proposals and rechecks the library.
settings.field.language.label: Dub language to look for
settings.field.language.help: primary language – the one you want in all your movies and series
settings.field.secondLanguage.label: Second language
settings.field.secondLanguage.help: usually the original (English) – the ideal file has both languages
settings.field.uiLanguage.label: Interface language
settings.field.uiLanguage.help: texts of the web UI, log and notifications
settings.scan.title: Library scanning
settings.scan.lead: When and how often to look for better versions. Every search queries all indexers in Prowlarr – hence one at a time, with a pause.
settings.field.scannerEnabled.label: Scan the library automatically
settings.field.scannerEnabled.help: off = searches run only when you click in the Library
settings.field.scanRadarr.label: Movies
settings.field.scanSonarr.label: Series
settings.field.searchIntervalSec.label: Pause between searches
settings.field.searchIntervalSec.help: shorter = faster pass, more load on the indexers
settings.field.maxSearchesPerDay.label: Daily search limit
settings.field.recheckDays.label: Retry after
settings.field.recheckDays.help: when nothing better was found last time
settings.field.watchIntervalDays.label: Retry watched items after
settings.field.watchIntervalDays.help: watching is turned on for a movie or series in the Library (eye icon)
settings.field.librarySyncMin.label: Reload the library from Radarr/Sonarr every
settings.field.autoWatchNew.label: Watch newly added
settings.field.autoWatchNew.help: a movie or series that appears in the library for the first time is watched automatically – if it's downloaded only in {s}, say, an upgrade to all wanted languages keeps being searched for
settings.field.autoWatchNew.opt.off.help: new titles are scanned like the rest of the library
settings.field.autoWatchNew.opt.auto.hel: a confident upgrade is downloaded without asking – you just get a notification
settings.field.autoWatchNew.opt.ask.help: checked more often, upgrades are offered in Proposals
settings.criteria.title: What counts as an upgrade
settings.criteria.lead: Order: {p} + {s} › {p} › {s}; with the same language, higher resolution wins.
settings.field.verifySpeech.label: Verify the language by listening
settings.field.verifySpeech.help: listens to the tracks (whisper) before proposing – catches e.g. a track in another language tagged as “eng”
settings.field.localIndexers.label: Local indexers
settings.field.localIndexers.help: parts of indexer names – a “MULTI” release from these is treated as likely {p}
settings.field.qualityUpgrades.label: Offer better quality too
settings.field.allowLowerQualityForLangu: Better language even at a lower resolution
e.g. {p} 720p instead of {s} 1080p – the proposal gets a warning
settings.field.minResolution.label: Resolution
settings.field.minResolution.help: nothing outside this range is offered
settings.field.maxMovieSizeGB.label: Max. movie size
settings.field.maxEpisodeSizeGB.label: Max. episode size
settings.series.title: Series
settings.series.lead: Full seasons, multi-season packs and sets of individual episodes.
settings.field.multiSeasonPacks.label: Multi-season packs
settings.field.multiSeasonPacks.help: e.g. “S01-S04 ({p}/{s})” – one proposal for all affected seasons
settings.field.episodeSets.label: Sets of individual episodes
settings.field.episodeSets.help: when there's no pack but every episode has a better version
settings.field.maxEpisodeSetParts.label: Max. torrents per set
settings.download.title: Download and import
settings.download.lead: When to download without asking, what to do with dead torrents and how to handle a rejected import.
settings.field.autoGrab.label: Download without asking
settings.field.autoGrab.help: applies to the whole library – watched items always download automatically
settings.field.autoGrab.opt.off.help: you approve every upgrade in Proposals
settings.field.autoGrab.opt.target.help: downloads only the target version with a verified language
settings.field.autoMinSeeders.label: Min. seeds to download without asking
settings.field.minSeeders.label: Min. seeds
settings.field.minSeeders.help: fewer = the release is considered dead and isn't offered
settings.field.stallHours.label: Dead after
settings.field.retryOnStall.label: Try the next candidate
settings.field.retryOnStall.help: when stalled or failed – the dead torrent gets blocklisted
settings.field.maxRetries.label: Max. attempts
settings.field.qbitStopStalled.label: Stop stalled torrents
settings.field.qbitStopStalled.help: all of them in qBittorrent, not just Updaterr's – frees up queue slots; forced and manually stopped ones are left alone
settings.field.qbitStallMin.label: Stop after
settings.field.qbitStallRetryMin.label: Retry after
settings.field.qbitStallRetryMin.help: stopped ones are restarted to check whether they can download now
settings.field.forceImport.label: Force import
settings.field.forceImport.help: when Radarr/Sonarr rejects the file as “not an upgrade”
settings.field.qbitRemoveImported.label: Delete torrent after import
settings.field.qbitRemoveImported.help: from qBittorrent including the downloaded files – the imported copy stays in the library · turn off if you want to seed (mind your ratio on private trackers)
settings.merge.title: Audio track merging
settings.merge.lead: Instead of replacing the whole file, downloads just a release with the missing language and adds its track. Sync is verified by comparing the audio at 8 points.
settings.field.mergeEnabled.label: Offer merging
settings.field.mergeEnabled.help: the track is added to the existing file via mkvmerge
settings.field.mergePrimaryDefault.label: Make the added {p} track the default
settings.field.mergeMaxDonorGB.label: Max. donor size for movies
settings.field.mergeMaxDonorGB.help: for series, the max. episode size applies
settings.field.mergeMaxOffsetSec.label: Max. track offset to search
settings.field.mergeDeleteDonor.label: Delete the donor after merging
settings.field.mergeDeleteDonor.help: mind your ratio on private trackers
settings.field.keepBackupDays.label: Keep the original file for
settings.field.keepBackupDays.help: after completion · also applies to sync fixes · overview and manual management in the Backups tab
settings.field.maxBackupGB.label: Max. space for backups
settings.field.maxBackupGB.help: 0 = no limit · the oldest backups are deleted above the limit
settings.sync.lead: For files with both a {p} and an {s} track, a background check measures whether the dub matches the original. Only a small part of the file is read, at the lowest priority. Fixes happen only when you click in an item's details.
settings.field.syncCheckEnabled.label: Check in the background
settings.field.syncCheckEnabled.help: never runs at the same time as merging
settings.field.syncCheckPauseSec.label: Pause between files
settings.field.syncCheckPauseSec.help: at least 3× the length of one measurement
settings.field.syncWarnMs.label: Warn from an offset of
settings.gpu.title: GPU
settings.gpu.lead: Speech recognition (Whisper) for verifying the language by listening runs on the GPU. Sync measurement and track merging are limited by disk reads, where a GPU wouldn't help.
settings.field.useGpu.label: Use the GPU
settings.field.useGpu.help: Whisper via Vulkan – if the GPU is missing or fails, the CPU takes over automatically
settings.field.speechModel.label: Model
settings.field.speechModel.help: applies to both GPU and CPU
settings.field.speechModel.opt.small.hel: better with less common languages (e.g. Czech, Slovak) · about 3× slower on the CPU, recommended with a GPU
settings.gpu.check.label: Test the GPU
settings.gpu.check.help: checks the device mapping into the container, permissions and the Vulkan driver, then runs Whisper on a test recording and compares the result with the CPU
settings.notify.title: Notifications
settings.notify.lead: Telegram (with “Download” buttons) or ntfy. Channels are enabled in .env.
settings.field.notifyProposals.label: New proposals
settings.field.notifyDownloads.label: Download results
settings.field.mergeSaveData.label: Save data
settings.field.mergeSaveData.help: recommends the smallest suitable audio source – the video isn't taken from it, so a smaller release is enough
settings.field.backupDeleteVerified.labe: Delete the backup after a verified merge
settings.field.backupDeleteVerified.help: the library file is compared with the backup (video, duration, tracks, sync) · if they differ, the backup stays and you get a notification
settings.notify.test.label: Try it
settings.notify.test.help: sends a test message to all enabled channels
settings.live.cap: With a {iv} s pause it manages at most {cap} searches a day – the limit of {lim} won't be reached.
settings.live.limit: The limit of {lim} searches is used up in about {dur}, then it waits until midnight.
settings.live.queue: The queue of {items} will be worked through in about {dur}.
settings.live.gpuBad: {what} – speech recognition runs on the CPU
confirm.grab.lowerRes: The picture gets worse for the sake of a better language: lower resolution than the current one ({from} → {to}).
confirm.bulk.title: Check again?
confirm.bulk.text: This queues {items} {which}. Searches run one at a time every {sec} s, so it takes about {dur}.
confirm.syncfix.title: Fix the dub sync?
confirm.syncfix.text: {warn} ({lag}). I'll create a new file with the {p} track shifted, measure it again and only if it matches, import it via {app}. The original file is kept as a backup for {days} days. It takes a few minutes.
confirm.cancel.title: Cancel the download?
confirm.cancel.text: The torrent is removed from the client along with the downloaded data. The original file stays unchanged.
confirm.bkdelete.title: Delete the backup?
confirm.bkdelete.hardlink: The files are also in the library (hardlink), so no space is freed.
confirm.bkdelete.final: The original file can't be restored afterwards.
confirm.retention.text: With the new retention, these are deleted right away: {list}. This frees {size}. The original files can't be restored afterwards.
confirm.syncfixAll.title: Fix sync for all?

confirm.syncfixAll.text.one: I'll start a fix for {count} item with an out-of-sync dub. Fixes run one at a time: for each, I'll create a new file with the {p} track shifted, measure it again and only if it matches, import it. The original files are kept as a backup for {days} days. Each fix takes a few minutes.
confirm.syncfixAll.text.other: I'll start a fix for {count} items with an out-of-sync dub. Fixes run one at a time: for each, I'll create a new file with the {p} track shifted, measure it again and only if it matches, import it. The original files are kept as a backup for {days} days. Each fix takes a few minutes.

toast.fixAll.other: {count} fixes started{skipped} – progress is in Activity

codec.none.label: Don't care
codec.none.help: default – the video format isn't tracked
codec.hevc.help: if the file is H.264 or older, the same language and resolution is searched for in H.265 (HEVC) or AV1
codec.av1.label: AV1 only
codec.av1.help: if the file isn't AV1, the same language and resolution is searched for in AV1
codec.title: Video format
codec.note: A newer codec = the same picture in a smaller file – but the player has to support it (otherwise the media server transcodes it).
notif.title: Notifications
activity.cancelledForeign: Cancelled a download that {app} started itself:
activity.openOffer: Open the proposal with another version
activity.type.firstTitle: Newly added – the release was picked by Updaterr instead of Radarr/Sonarr
badDonors.title: Torrents unsuitable for adding audio
badDonors.text: Merging with them failed, so they're no longer downloaded – not even under another name or from another indexer.
badDonors.unblockTitle: May be offered again at the next search
bulk.title: Bulk check
bulk.alreadyRunning: Listening is already running – {n} of {total} left. New items are added to the end.
bulk.intro: Applies to {where} ({items}). Runs gradually in the background; searching takes priority over listening.
bulk.listen.title: Listen to unverified
bulk.listen.text: Whisper listens to the tracks and fixes mislabeled languages. Anything that turns out worse than its tag claimed is queued for search right away.
bulk.listenAll.title: Listen to everything again
bulk.listenAll.text: Including already verified ones – useful after changing the model in Settings → Graphics card.
bulk.listenAll.textModel: Including already verified ones – useful after changing the model (now {model}) in Settings → Graphics card.
bulk.search1.title: Without a {p} dub
bulk.search2.title: Without {p} + {s}
confirm.listenStop.title: Stop listening?
confirm.listenStop.text: Items still in the queue ({n}) won't be listened to. What's already verified stays.
confirm.mergeSet.title: Add audio from a set of episodes?
confirm.mergeSet.text: {torrents} ({size}) will be downloaded; only the {lang} audio is taken from each into the existing episode. The video stays.
drawer.truncatedText: {file} min of the {runtime}-min film – no audio is added, only a whole-file replacement is offered, after approval
jellyseerr.ok: Jellyseerr doesn't start a search in Radarr or Sonarr after adding – Updaterr picks.
jellyseerr.on: Jellyseerr starts a search in {names} after adding – Radarr/Sonarr then downloads by itself and Updaterr cancels that download a moment later. Turn it off:
jellyseerr.step4Each: Click Save Changes – for each server separately.
kind.cutmatchTitle: Downloads the cut of the film the {lang} dub fits, and adds the audio to it after import
library.bulkTitle: Listen to the audio tracks or search for better versions of many items at once
library.heardTip: Verified by listening – the tags match the speech
listen.allOk: For all items the language matches the actual speech.
listen.restByTags: For the others the language comes from the track tags, which can lie.
option.retryMergeTitle: Unblocks the torrent for adding audio and searches the item again
settings.first.title: New movies and series
settings.first.lead: A movie or series added e.g. from Jellyseerr is downloaded right away by Updaterr using its own rules ({p} + {s} › {p} › {s}, then resolution) instead of Radarr/Sonarr – so the same thing isn't downloaded twice (first Radarr's version, right after it the upgrade).
settings.field.firstGrab.label: Updaterr picks the first download
settings.field.firstGrab.help: new = without a file and appearing among the missing only now: added, newly released, newly monitored season · what is missing today is left to Radarr/Sonarr
settings.field.firstGrabMovies.label: Movies
settings.field.firstGrabSeries.label: Series
settings.field.firstGrabSeries.help: whole seasons from Sonarr, also multi-season packs · episodes still airing are downloaded by Sonarr
settings.field.firstGrabCancelArr.label: Cancel their download
settings.field.firstGrabCancelArr.help: when they manage to grab a different release first (search after adding, RSS) than Updaterr picked · the same release is left to them
settings.field.firstGrabFallback.label: Nothing suitable → Radarr/Sonarr searches
settings.field.firstGrabFallback.help: when Updaterr finds nothing or all attempts fail, it starts their search · from then on only upgrades
settings.field.mergeCredit.label: Credit in the added track's name
settings.field.mergeCredit.help: the player shows e.g. “{name} (By: Updaterr)” · applies to newly merged files
settings.live.firstIdle: New items are checked every minute – with the On Movie Added / On Series Add webhook in Radarr/Sonarr right away.
toast.listenNothing: Everything is already queued or verified
toast.retryMerge: Unblocked – the item will be searched again and “Add audio” offered again
toast.unblocked: Unblocked – the torrent may be offered again at the next search
trunc.title: The file is much shorter than the film (truncated or damaged). No audio is added to it; a whole-file replacement is offered – always only after approval.
